_scale: 0 none | 1 aware | 2 can use with docs | 3 builds independently | 4 designs, debugs, teaches, passes senior interviews | 5 expert. Levels change only with evidence (see CLAUDE.md).

dsa.name: DSA / problem solving
dsa.target_bar: Medium in ~25 min, Hard with hints; patterns (graphs, DP, heaps, intervals, sliding window) automatic.
dsa.minimum: Solve ONE easy/medium problem you have not seen; stop at 20 min and read the solution if stuck.
dsa.deep: Timed 2-problem mock (45 min), then write the pattern name and a 3-line recap for each.

system_design.name: System design (HLD)
system_design.target_bar: Drive a 45-min design: requirements, estimates, APIs, data model, scaling, failure modes, trade-offs.
system_design.minimum: Read one classic design (URL shortener, rate limiter, feed) and list 3 trade-offs from memory.
system_design.deep: Design a system on paper in 45 min, then compare with a reference answer and list what you missed.

lld.name: Low-level design / OOP patterns
lld.target_bar: Model parking lot / splitwise / rate limiter in clean Java with SOLID and 2-3 patterns in 45 min.
lld.minimum: Pick one design pattern and write a 30-line Java example from memory.
lld.deep: Code a full LLD problem (classes, interfaces, tests) in 60 min without looking.

java.name: Java core, concurrency, JVM
java.target_bar: Explain and use CompletableFuture, executors, locks, happens-before, GC choices, virtual threads; read a heap dump.
java.minimum: Answer 5 Java concurrency/JVM interview questions aloud, check against a reference.
java.deep: Write a small concurrent program (producer/consumer or rate limiter), break it with a race, fix it, benchmark.

spring_micro.name: Spring Boot & microservices
spring_micro.target_bar: Explain resilience (circuit breaker, retries, idempotency), saga/outbox, API versioning, service-to-service auth.
spring_micro.minimum: Add one resilience or idempotency feature to a small service, or explain one aloud.
spring_micro.deep: Implement the outbox pattern or a saga across two services in your side project, with a test.

sql_db.name: SQL & relational DB internals
sql_db.target_bar: Read EXPLAIN plans, pick indexes, explain isolation levels, deadlocks, partitioning, replication.
sql_db.minimum: Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on one your side project query and note what the plan does.
sql_db.deep: Seed 1M rows, tune three slow queries with indexes, record before/after timings in a short write-up.

messaging_cache.name: Kafka / messaging & Redis caching
messaging_cache.target_bar: Explain partitions, consumer groups, delivery semantics, ordering, cache-aside/write-through, eviction, stampede.
messaging_cache.minimum: Read one Kafka or Redis concept page and explain it back in 5 sentences.
messaging_cache.deep: Add Kafka (events) and Redis (cache-aside) to your side project; test failure and replay behaviour.

cloud.name: Cloud (AWS) in practice
cloud.target_bar: Deploy a service with ECS/EKS or EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC basics, load balancer, alarms; explain cost and failure modes.
cloud.minimum: Do one AWS hands-on lab step (IAM policy, S3 bucket policy, or security group).
cloud.deep: Deploy your side project's backend to AWS (free tier) behind a load balancer with a managed DB.

devops.name: CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes
devops.target_bar: Own a CI pipeline, containerise and deploy to Kubernetes, explain rollout, probes, config and secrets.
devops.minimum: Write or fix one step of a GitHub Actions workflow for your side project.
devops.deep: Run your side project on a local kind/minikube cluster with a Deployment, Service, probes and config.

testing.name: Testing & quality
testing.target_bar: Add integration tests with Testcontainers, contract tests, and explain test strategy trade-offs.
testing.minimum: Add one meaningful test for an untested edge case.
testing.deep: Introduce Testcontainers for the Postgres-backed tests in your side project.

frontend.name: Frontend (React/TS/Angular)
frontend.minimum: Skip unless it blocks a project.

ai_agents.name: Agentic AI / LLM engineering
ai_agents.target_bar: Build and evaluate a tool-using agent and a RAG pipeline; handle evals, cost, latency, guardrails, MCP.
ai_agents.minimum: Read one agent/RAG/eval write-up and note one idea to try.
ai_agents.deep: Build a small agent with tools plus an eval set that scores it, and publish it on GitHub.

security.name: Security / applied crypto
security.target_bar: At bar. Be able to explain OWASP top 10 and auth flows.
security.minimum: Explain OAuth2/OIDC flow aloud in 2 minutes.
security.deep: Harden your side project auth (refresh rotation, rate limiting) and document it.

observability.name: Observability & performance
observability.target_bar: Add metrics, tracing and logs; load-test with k6/JMeter; find and fix a bottleneck from data.
observability.minimum: Add one Micrometer metric or trace span to a service.
observability.deep: Add Prometheus and Grafana to your side project, load-test, and fix the slowest endpoint.

communication.name: Interview communication & behavioural
communication.target_bar: STAR stories for 6 themes, think aloud while coding, structured trade-off talk, negotiation ready.
communication.minimum: Say one STAR story aloud (record it) and cut it to 2 minutes.
communication.deep: Full mock interview with a peer or recorded self-review; fix the top 2 issues.

brand.name: Public proof (GitHub, LinkedIn, writing)
brand.target_bar: 2-3 polished public repos, a LinkedIn that matches the resume, 1 post per 2 weeks, one OSS contribution.
brand.minimum: Improve one README or LinkedIn section.
brand.deep: Publish a write-up on a real engineering result (e.g. the 250K fares performance approach, sanitised).
